subject: english
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative. 

I did not ___________ everyone all at once.
solution:
The correct answer is "**lose.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in past tense as indicated by the verb "did."
 
• **The verb that follows "did" should be used in its base form.**
 
• ** Among the given options, the correct verb in its base form "lose."**
 
 
• "Lose" means to become unable to find something.(खोना)
 
 
 
• ​Thus, the correct sentence will be: 
 
 
• ​I did not lose everyone all at once.
 
 

​​Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Losing" is a present participle and does not fit the past tense context.
 
• "Lost" is a past tense form, it implies that the action has already happened, whereas the sentence suggests that the speaker has not yet lost everyone. 
 
• "Loose" is an adjective meaning not tight or relaxed, and does not fit the context of the sentence.
